verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Galileo's tracing, out-of-the-box and custom eval metrics, and metric-based alerts on cost or correctness. None of it describes building custom dashboards or charts over latency, error, cost, or eval-score metrics. Alerting and metric definition are adjacent features and cannot stand in for user-built dashboards, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
